_comment: Repo-owned defaults and schema for Loom /attrs/anndata_mapping. Keys named _comment are documentation only and are not written into Loom files. AnndataMappingBuilder/PersistService fill a per-loom instance at parse (matrix roles from input_group/Annots) and complete it after analysis_pipeline refresh (obsm/varm/categoricals). loom_to_h5ad.v8.py / loom_to_h5ad_chunked.v8.py (asap_run) require this attr and use it as the sole matrix/embedding map for H5AD export. Spec: docs/loom-creation-spec-for-h5ad-roundtrip.md
title: AnnData mapping defaults for ASAP Loom
description: Fixed ASAP Loom orientation and path prefixes for deterministic Loom -> H5AD conversion. File-specific keys (x_path, raw_x_path, layers, obsm, varm, obsp, varp, categoricals) must be filled at loom write time from the datasets actually present.

file_specific_empty_stubs._comment: Writers should replace these with real maps for datasets present in the loom. Omit raw_x_path when no raw matrix exists. Do not map the same dataset path under both raw_x_path and layers.

asap_storage_conventions._comment: What ASAP actually writes today (genes x cells). Declare these concrete paths in anndata_mapping; do not invent /embeddings or /pairwise groups unless a writer starts creating them.
asap_storage_conventions.uns_json: /attrs/{key} (JSON string copied into uns as text, e.g. analysis_pipeline)
asap_storage_conventions.uns_groups: /attrs/{key} (HDF5 group copied into uns/{key}; spatial is scFAIR uns/spatial)
asap_storage_conventions.notes: Cell (obs) embeddings and multi-dim cell arrays live under /col_attrs. Gene (var) multi-dim arrays would live under /row_attrs. Pairwise graphs (obsp/varp) are not a standard ASAP loom layout today.

case_a_raw_primary._comment: raw selected as primary: /matrix stores raw, normalized X in a layer. Visium: obsm.spatial is coordinates; uns_groups.spatial is the scFAIR uns/spatial HDF5 group (images, scalefactors, is_single), not JSON.

case_b_normalized_primary._comment: normalized X selected as primary: /matrix stores X, no raw matrix
